{"type":"home","blocks":[{"type":"header","text":{"type":"plain_text","text":"🧭 CoachAven"}},{"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"I'm a coding agent living in your project channels — mention me to investigate, build, and open PRs without leaving Slack."}},{"type":"divider"},{"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*Projects* (1)"}},{"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"• *beta* — #aven-beta
   1 repo: `beta`"}},{"type":"divider"},{"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*How to use me*"}},{"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"• *Build / collaborate* — @-mention me with a task in a project channel. I reply in a thread; keep replying (no need to re-mention) and I remember the conversation.
• *Quick private answer* — `/aven <question>` in a project channel. I answer privately in our DM.
• *DM me directly* — just message me in a DM; if it's not clear which project you mean, I'll show a picker.
• *Schedule a digest* — `/aven schedule weekdays 9:00 | what to report` posts a recurring read-only summary here; `/aven schedule task weekdays 19:30 | what to do` runs a job that may edit and commit as the project's instructions say; manage with `/aven routines` (`/aven routines all` lists every job across this workspace's projects). Routine results arrive as a thread — reply there to continue with the same context.
• *Share files* — drop screenshots, PDFs, or docs into a thread or DM (with or without a note) and I'll read them as part of the task; works in Slack Connect channels too. If I can't use a file, I'll reply saying which one and why. _(Voice/video not supported yet.)_
• *Jot a note* — start a message with `!` and I'll stay out of it (no agent run).
• *Stop me* — hit *✖ Cancel* on any working message.
• *See how I got there* — hit *🧭 Show steps* on a working message (live) or a finished answer for the tool-by-tool trail in a pop-up; a very long run comes condensed.
• *Background agents* — if I kick off a background subagent that's still running when I reply, I'll follow up with a new *🔔 Background update* message in the thread once it finishes. (A sandbox nobody is using may be put to sleep after a while; background work still running then ends with it.)
• *Long tasks* — if a task runs long I won't cut it off: past ~15 minutes the working message stops ticking and turns into a *🌙 Working in the background* card (*🧭 Show steps* still live, *✖ Cancel* still stops me), and the answer arrives as a *new message* in the thread when it's done.
• *Review a PR* — `/aven review <PR url or #number> [low|med|high]` posts a read-only review here (works in DMs too). `/aven review auto on|off [effort]` reviews new PRs automatically _(managed from the project's owner workspace)_.
• *Watch a PR* — `/aven autofix <PR>` pings here on CI failures / new reviews with a *Fix* button (`/aven autofix off <PR>` / `list`)."}},{"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"• *Auto-investigate support tickets* — tag a YouTrack ticket with the agreed label and I open a thread in the matching project channel: the ticket card (description, priority, links, files — *🔍 Full ticket* pops up the whole thing, comments included) followed by a read-only investigation, then I ping the owners. Reply in that thread to dig deeper (I keep the context) or ask me there to implement the fix and open a pull request, or hit *📝 Report to YouTrack* to post an internal comment back to the ticket — a pop-up takes your instructions (a one-liner is fine; fixed delivery rules are always appended), then the draft comes back for review/edit before posting (or tick _post immediately_ to send the answer word-for-word) (pilot; only for projects with a YouTrack mapping above). The card shows *who* flagged the ticket, and the writeup follows the ticket's own language so support can relay it — except when one of the team's own accounts applies the tag, which gets you the answer in English.
• *What's here* — `/aven access` shows this channel's repos + tools.
• *Inspect my context* — `/aven memory` shows what I've learned, with a button per topic to drill in (`/aven memory <topic>` also works, `/aven memory live` reads the sandbox now, `/aven memory log` shows snapshot history); `/aven prompt` shows my system prompt.
• *Memory upkeep* — `/aven dream on`/`off` schedules (or pauses) nightly memory consolidation; `/aven dream` for status, `/aven dream now` to run it once.
• *Sandbox upkeep* — `/aven housekeeping on`/`off` schedules (or pauses) the nightly janitor (dockerd guard, docker prune when disk runs high, stale-worktree reap); `/aven housekeeping` for the last run, `/aven housekeeping now` to run it once.
• *Status* — `/aven status` for a live view of sandboxes, sessions, open PRs — and (operators) the Claude subscription quota.
• *Check or restart a thread* — hit *⚙️ Session* on any finished answer for a private status card (session, repos/tools, running turn, PR) and a *🔄 Restart session* control if you want the next message to start a brand-new conversation.
• *Tell me if it landed* — every answer carries *👍 Helped* / *👎 Missed*. One click is enough; the count on the button updates so you see it registered, and a thumbs-down asks what went wrong in a short pop-up. Nothing is posted in the thread; click the other button to change your mind.
• *Usage* — `/aven usage [days]` for token/cost/turn totals per project (and per routine, for scheduled ones), plus how many answers people rated as helpful and what those cost — per-turn figures, last 30d by default; records from before the per-turn cost fix are listed separately as legacy. _(Operators' home workspace only.)_"}},{"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"• *Who may drive me* — `/aven users` shows this workspace's access (everyone, by default); admins can `restrict` to an allowlist and manage it with `allow @user` / `deny @user` / `open`.
• *Reload config* — `/aven reload` re-reads the project registry (projects.config.json + projects.d/*.md prompts) without a restart; applies to new sessions. _(Operators' home workspace only.)_
• *Connected sources* — projects with linked mail, chat or calendar archives are pulled every 15 minutes on the bot host and scrubbed before anything reaches me; ask me about a thread or a meeting and I cite the original.
• *Pasted secrets stay here* — passwords, tokens, API keys and connection strings in what you type are redacted to `[REDACTED:…]` before the model sees them (same secret → same tag, so I can still tell them apart). Prefer linking to a vault entry over pasting a credential; if I ask for one, give me a *reference*, not the value."}},{"type":"context","elements":[{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"I work on a dedicated branch and open a PR for review — I never push straight to the default branch. _(Voice/video clips aren't supported yet — paste text or a link for those.)_"}]}]}
